description: This file defines the 'Channel' class within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace, implementing WebSocket link handling, including message packaging, serialization/deserialization, and connection management. It also declares related nested classes and virtual methods for handling WebSocket communication and JSON message processing.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket communication channel, managing message exchange, connection state, and message serialization/deserialization within the plugin framework.

classes.name: Channel::Package
classes.description: A utility class for encapsulating either JSON or text data to be sent or received over the channel.

classes.name: Channel::SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of JSON elements for outbound messages.

classes.name: Channel::DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming message streams into JSON elements.

methods.name: Channel(const SOCKET& connector, const Core::NodeId& remoteId)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the channel with a socket connector and remote node ID.

methods.name: ~Channel()
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: HasActivity()
methods.description: Checks if the channel has activity, possibly triggering a ping if idle.

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Returns the name of the channel.

methods.name: Id()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the channel.

methods.name: State()
methods.description: Returns the current state of the channel.

methods.name: IsNotified()
methods.description: Checks if the channel has notification flag set.

methods.name: Submit(const string& text)
methods.description: Submits a text message to be sent over the channel.

methods.name: Submit(const Core::ProxyType<Core::JSON::IElement>& entry)
methods.description: Submits a JSON element to be sent.

methods.name: Submit(const Core::ProxyType<Web::Response>& entry)
methods.description: Submits a Web::Response object for sending.

methods.name: RequestOutbound()
methods.description: Triggers the channel to send outbound data.

methods.name: SetId(const uint32_t id)
methods.description: Sets the unique ID for the channel.

methods.name: Lock()
methods.description: Locks the internal critical section.

methods.name: Unlock()
methods.description: Unlocks the internal critical section.

methods.name: Properties(const uint32_t offset)
methods.description: Sets the property offset for the channel.

methods.name: State(const ChannelState state, const bool notification)
methods.description: Sets the current state and notification flag.

methods.name: Serialize(uint8_t* dataFrame, const uint16_t maxSendSize)
methods.description: Serializes data for sending over the channel.

methods.name: Deserialize(const uint8_t* dataFrame, const uint16_t receivedSize)
methods.description: Deserializes incoming data stream.

methods.name: LinkBody(Core::ProxyType<Request>& request)
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle incoming web requests.

methods.name: Received(Core::ProxyType<Request>& request)
methods.description: Pure virtual method called when a request is received.

methods.name: Send(const Core::ProxyType<Web::Response>& response)
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send a response.

methods.name: Send(const Core::ProxyType<Core::JSON::IElement>& element)
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send a JSON element.

methods.name: Element(const string& identifier)
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get a JSON element by identifier.

methods.name: Received(Core::ProxyType<Core::JSON::IElement>& element)
methods.description: Pure virtual method called when a JSON element is received.

methods.name: SendData(uint8_t* dataFrame, const uint16_t maxSendSize)
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send raw data.

methods.name: ReceiveData(uint8_t* dataFrame, const uint16_t receivedSize)
methods.description: Pure virtual method to receive raw data.

methods.name: Received(const string& text)
methods.description: Pure virtual method called when text data is received.

methods.name: StateChange()
methods.description: Pure virtual method called on state change.
